x1.reason: A database error in the cookie-lifetime lookup after a successful first sample returns 500 without the cookie; the sandbox stays open until it expires and the sweep deletes it (at most 55 minutes).
x1.fix: Compute the lifetime from the reservation's expiry already in memory, or close the sandbox in the same cleanup handler.

x2.reason: Two first sends from two tabs can still each create a sandbox in browsers without the Web Locks API (all current major browsers have it). The orphan expires and is swept within 55 minutes. Mythos asked for Web Locks with a fall-through; required again before uploads (PR 2).
x2.fix: Serialise first sends server-side per address hash for a few seconds, if PR 2 needs it.

x3.reason: A review admitted just before the sweep goes stale can still reach Temporal after its body is read. The window is the body read (16 KB max) and only adds a dismiss reason to a history the sweep deletes.
x3.fix: Re-check freshness after reading the body, before signalling Temporal.

x4.reason: Same as slice ad7635 x1: the stale 202 copy overclaims after a lock timeout.

x5.reason: The load runner accepts run lengths longer than a sandbox's life, so a 50-minute run reports expected refusals as failures. Operator tool only; the documented runs are minutes long.
x5.fix: Refuse --duration above the sandbox lifetime minus the refusal window.

x6.reason: Same as slice ad7635 x1, raised by the security pass as a hardening note.
